**Subject: Denver Office Moving to 1550 Wazee Street on October 1**

Hi team,

We're excited to announce that our Denver office will move to a new location at **1550 Wazee Street** on **October 1**.

Here's what to expect:

- **Smaller footprint:** The new space occupies two fewer floors, which helps us reduce costs and encourages closer collaboration.
- **New bike room:** A dedicated, secure bike room will make commuting on two wheels easier.
- **App-based desk booking:** Desks will be reserved through an app, so you can plan your in-office days and reserve a spot that suits your work.

Facilities will share packing guidelines, move-day logistics, and onboarding instructions for the booking app in the coming weeks. Please start sorting and clearing out personal items from your current workspace.

If you have questions or accessibility needs, contact the Facilities team at any time. We'll keep you updated as the move approaches.

Thank you for your flexibility and enthusiasm as we get settled into our new home.

Best,
[Name]
[Title]

---

One note: today is November 24, 2026, so if October 1 refers to a past date, you may want to confirm the year or adjust the timing language.
